0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (8-4, 2nd in the Pacific) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with San Antonio on a 10-game winning streak and 6-0 on the road. Golden State, 7th in the West, has lost its most recent game after winning eight of its last 10, and the Spurs are without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while the Warriors are missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdomen soreness and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Spurs winning the last meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026, and they have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
